hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880112 (23 Modern Electric and 11 Rustic Electric sites list 50-amp, 10 Modern Electric list 30-amp; no site lists water or sewer) + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/kettle-creek-state-park/stay ('41 sites with electricity', '12 with electric hook-ups'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Two campgrounds. Lower Campground along Kettle Creek: 33 Modern Electric sites on the booking site (DCNR says 41 with electricity), max vehicle lengths 25-45 ft; pets prohibited. Upper Campground overlooking Kettle Creek Reservoir: 11 Rustic Electric and 11 Rustic Non-Electric sites (16-40 ft) plus 4 tent sites; pets permitted. Every site is listed back-in.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/kettle-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880112 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: Modern restrooms with showers in the Lower Campground; vault toilets in the Upper Campground.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/kettle-creek-state-park/stay ('Water spigots are scattered throughout the campgrounds', 'modern restrooms with showers', '12 with electric hook-ups and vault toilets'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/kettle-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880112 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window; season already manual (Lower early April-mid December, Upper to mid-October). Added 50-amp electric (no water/sewer listed), 55 RV sites to 45 ft (all back-in), showers (Lower) / vault toilets (Upper) / water spigots. Not stated for this park: minimum/maximum stay, noon cutoff, fcfs, dump station, flush toilets in so many words. Fees left at the statewide table.
